subject: Civics
learningObjectives: Functioning of Gram Sabha and Gram Panchayat
Three levels of Panchayats (Gram, Block, Zila)
misconceptions: Gram Sabha and Gram Panchayat are the same (Sabha is the assembly of all adults)

practiceExercises.question: Who is the head of the Gram Panchayat?
practiceExercises.explanation: The Panchayat members (Panches) elect a Sarpanch as the head.

flashcards.back: Meeting of all adults who live in the area
District level of the Panchayat system

revisionNotes: Panchayati Raj is the first tier of democratic government.
commonMistakes: Confusing the Secretary (govt appointed) with Sarpanch (elected)
